Definition: from a compound of G1537 and G2192 (meaning to stand out); prominence (figuratively):--principal.
BiblicalUsage: The word exochḗ carries the sense of principal. In Acts 25:23, the text says "and principal men of the city."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, exochḗ means principal, and I leave it at that.
RelatedEvents: Paul Before Felix, Festus, and Agrippa
